decisions.reason: The existing same-message Event changes the winner count and sales cadence but leaves the obsolete pool-balance draw_trigger in state.

source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text:
I just had a thought.... I think we need to tweak the block prizes to
- Small = 1 x $500 every 100 sales.
- Big = 1 x $10,000 every 10,000 sales.

Same net $ amount given away but smoother, cleaner, clearer and more consistent stream of winners

decisions.reason: The source changes prize winner counts and draw cadence but does not change which sales fund the pools or the funding duration.
The no-referral recipient rule and its Small and Big Block ticket awards remain valid despite the changed prize cadence.
The source does not remove either prize block or change the requirement to expose the two ticket counters and permanent badges.
The source explicitly preserves the net prize amount and does not change the mint price, founder share, commission, or primary-mint pool funding.
Changing prize frequency and winner count does not alter the required flat $10 secondary-sale royalty.
The source does not resolve or change whether prizes are paid automatically or claimed manually.
A complete same-message MODIFY already records one $500 winner and replaces the prior pool-balance trigger with a 100-sale trigger.
The source changes the number and cadence of prizes but leaves random, ticket-weighted Chainlink VRF winner selection unchanged.
Prize cadence has no necessary effect on the Transak fiat on-ramp or its supported payment methods.
The source does not change confirmation-email availability or its referral-code content.
The prize-mechanics adjustment does not change the asset delivered by an NFT mint.
